artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom-most white leaf charm appears physically impossible; the loop connecting it to the chain seems to merge into the leaf body without a clear ring, and the leaf shape itself looks partially melted or fused with the background/chain.
The internal pattern of the purple bead looks like smeared paint rather than natural stone grain or glass swirl, lacking realistic depth.
Some gold links appear slightly flattened or inconsistently spaced, suggesting minor geometric instability in the generation of small repetitive structures.
